title: Governed database lifecycle and pressure relief contracts

phases.objective: Publish a complete, secret-free, contract-only Spec Kit with deterministic safety boundaries and a multi-PR implementation plan.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The lifecycle contract is complete, bounded, secret-free, and does not authorize runtime mutation.
steps: Load the Spec 019 documents and JSON schemas.
Verify the lifecycle stages, domain decisions, authority boundaries, receipts, readback, and error taxonomy.
Reject arbitrary SQL, wildcard authority, silent retention, and destructive defaults.
Report deterministic contract validation without contacting Production.
assertions: The Spec Kit contains specification, plan, tasks, data model, operations, research, threat model, checklists, contracts, E2E, and Work Map artifacts.
Engine runs remain plan-only when retention policy is missing.
Logical cleanup and physical reclaim are separate contracts.
No secrets or production mutation authority are included.

phases.objective: Implement read-only pressure observation and deterministic lifecycle planning after contract approval.
Add exact authority, durable receipts, bounded execution, reconciliation, and preservation-invariant tests.
Run the response-chunk pilot in non-production with fixed cutoff, readback, and rollback evidence.
Promote only after staging/canary/readback, security, performance, migration, and owner approval gates.
